map.💡 HCM 简化：S = 1900 × f_w × f_sw × f_HV；通行: 💡 HCM simplified: S = 1900 × f_w × f_sw × f_HV; capacity C ≈ S × 0.85 (practical operating limit); f_HV = 1/[1+P(E_T−1)], E_T≈2.0.

map.用高峰小时系数把通行能力折算为服务流率，与实际流量比较得饱和度 V/C。: Convert capacity to service flow rate with the peak hour factor and compare with actual flow to get saturation V/C.
map.按 V/C 判定服务水平 LOS（A~F），识别拥堵路段与扩容需求。: Determine level of service LOS (A~F) from V/C, identifying congested sections and expansion needs.
map.车道宽修正 f_w：≥3.6 m 取 1.0；3.0~3.6 m 取 1+(w−: Lane width correction f_w: ≥3.6 m takes 1.0; 3.0~3.6 m takes 1+(w−3.6)/2; <3.0 m takes 0.85−(3.0−w)×0.10. Shoulder correction f_sw: when <1.8 m take 1.0−(1.8−sw)×0.06, with a floor of 0.85. Heavy vehicle correction f_HV = 1/(1+p), where p is heavy vehicle share (passenger car equivalent E_T=2.0). Saturation flow rate S = 1900 × f_w × f_sw × f_HV (pc/h/ln); when design speed is <100 km/h multiply by (0.95+(v−100)×0.001). Capacity C = S × 0.85; service flow rate = C × PHF; V/C = actual flow ÷ C. LOS: ≤0.35 A, ≤0.55 B, ≤0.77 C, ≤0.90 D, ≤1.00 E, >1.00 F.
map.车道宽 3.5 m、路肩 1.0 m、设计速度 80 km/h、重型车 10%、: Lane width 3.5 m, shoulder 1.0 m, design speed 80 km/h, 10% heavy vehicles, PHF 0.9: f_w = 1+(3.5−3.6)/2 = 0.95; f_sw = 1.0−(1.8−1.0)×0.06 = 0.952; f_HV = 1/1.1 ≈ 0.909. S = 1900×0.95×0.952×0.909 ≈ 1563 pc/h/ln; the speed correction ×(0.95−0.02) = ×0.93 → 1454; C = 1454×0.85 ≈ 1236 veh/h; service flow rate = 1236×0.9 ≈ 1112 veh/h. If the actual flow is 1100 veh/h, V/C ≈ 0.89 → LOS D (approaching unstable flow).
map.为什么要乘 0.85 得通行能力？: Why multiply by 0.85 to get capacity?
map.饱和流率是理想条件下的最大流率，实际道路难以长期维持；工程上通常取饱和流率的 0: Saturation flow rate is the maximum flow under ideal conditions and cannot be sustained on real roads; in engineering practice about 0.85 of the saturation flow rate is taken as the reliable operating limit (near the LOS D/E boundary).
map.需求超过通行能力，出现持续排队与走走停停（LOS F）；此时延误急剧上升，需通过: Demand exceeds capacity, producing continuous queues and stop-and-go conditions (LOS F); delays then rise sharply and must be eased by adding lanes, optimizing signal timing or managing travel demand.
